heading: Officers of Senate
lead: Section 5503 of this title shall not apply to officers of the Senate.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 118a of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Jan. 3, 1979, see section 717 of Pub. L. 95–521, set out as a note under section 288 of this title.

ancestors.heading: HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES OFFICERS AND ADMINISTRATION
